How was grandma this week?.sql:
WITH __events AS (
  SELECT
    kind,
    intent,
    mood,
    status,
    source,
    text,
    ts,
    day,
    mood_score,
    heart_rate,
    ts AS event_count
  FROM teddy.core.events_flat
), current_week_events AS (
  SELECT
    kind,
    intent,
    mood,
    status,
    source,
    text,
    ts,
    day,
    mood_score,
    heart_rate,
    event_count
  FROM __events
  WHERE
    day >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CURRENT_DATE)
)

  MIN(day) AS week_start,
  MAX(day) AS week_end,
  AVG(CASE WHEN kind = 'mood' THEN mood_score END) AS avg_mood_score,
  AVG(CASE WHEN kind = 'vitals' THEN heart_rate END) AS avg_heart_rate,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN kind = 'alert' THEN 1 END) AS total_alerts,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN kind = 'alert' AND status = 'fallen' THEN 1 END) AS fall_alerts,

What has she been asking Teddy for?.sql:
WITH __events AS (
  SELECT
    kind,
    intent,
    ts
  FROM teddy.core.events_flat
)
SELECT
  intent,
  COUNT(*) AS request_count,
  MIN(ts) AS first_requested,
  MAX(ts) AS last_requested
FROM __events
